examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, Job 1:8 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
examples.english: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

glosses: (auf A) обращать внимание (на что-л., на кого-л.); присматривать (за чем-л.)
